tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Get supported languages, free vs paid operations, input limits, privacy posture, x402 pricing and billing status. Free. Call first when discovering this server.

tools.name: find_symbol
tools.description: Find and rank compiler symbols across supplied TypeScript/JavaScript files without returning the full symbols list. Free. Deterministic exact/case-insensitive/qualified-suffix/prefix/substring ranking with optional path and kind hints; returns ambiguous instead of guessing when the best decision key

tools.name: get_symbol_context
tools.description: Resolve one TypeScript/JavaScript symbol and return a bounded context packet. Omitted include is free and returns definition, callers and callees. Adding references or impact makes the single invocation paid via x402. Defaults to 4 rows per section with explicit totals and continuation offsets.

tools.name: query_code
tools.description: Generic compiler query over supplied JS/TS files. Free for symbols, callers, callees, and function. Paid via x402 (starting $0.02) when query is impact, references, imports, or importers. Prefer specialized tools when the intent is clear. Not a repository index.

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Find semantic references to a TypeScript or JavaScript symbol across supplied files using compiler-backed symbol identity. Handles renamed imports and re-exports. Paid via x402 (starting $0.02).

tools.name: get_imports
tools.description: Resolve a TypeScript or JavaScript file's imports to concrete modules, imported bindings, aliases and source locations. Paid via x402 (starting $0.02).

tools.name: get_importers
tools.description: Find modules and files that import a target TypeScript or JavaScript module, with resolved module edges and evidence. Paid via x402 (starting $0.02).

tools.name: analyze_impact
tools.description: Determine what code may be affected by changing a TypeScript or JavaScript symbol. Returns direct and transitive dependency paths with source evidence. Paid via x402 (starting $0.02).
